title: Balance the HVAC
description: Shape a smooth supply path that favors even-looking distribution while controlling restriction and path complexity.
hints: Sharp asymmetry usually makes distribution less predictable.
Use smooth, symmetric transitions when you want the flow field to divide more evenly.

showcase.fidelity_note: MVP uses a symmetric room/duct packaging proxy. It does not solve a true multi-branch duct network or room-by-room airflow balance; visual balance uses 2D field symmetry and restriction proxies only.
